game_title: Squad Marcher – Hollow Log Trail Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail, a trail through hollow logs: the wood elf archer must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Squad Marcher: Loop through a squad list with for ally in squad so each member gets its job.
theme: Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail: a trail through hollow logs
core_gameplay_loop: In Hollow Log Trail, repeat each round: Loop through a squad list with for ally in squad so each member gets its job. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the squad_ready value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the mushroom ring using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The mushroom ring reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the mushroom ring is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Squad Marcher
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
